children: Anavex Life Sciences regained Nasdaq compliance after filing its delayed Form 10-Qs for March 31 and June 30, 2026.
Received Nasdaq delinquency notice for late 10-Qs for quarter ended March 31, 2026, citing Rule 5250(c)(1).
Submitted a compliance plan to Nasdaq on July 20, 2026 to address the filing delinquency.
Filed Form 10-Qs for March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026 on August 28, 2026, resolving the delinquency.
Nasdaq confirmed the company has regained compliance and its shares will continue trading on the Global Select Market.
